verdict.rationale: Parsec documents a Teams API for deployment automation and audit logs, so the question of API versioning and deprecation applies. However, nothing in the evidence describes API versions, version pinning, or a deprecation or sunset policy. Probes for machine-readable API docs (OpenAPI spec, teams-api.md) all returned 404, so there is nothing that shows versioning practices.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
